nodes.name: Load Story & Character Poses (3A)
nodes.notes: Canonical story + character pose loader. Ensure interior uses poses 1–12; cover uses pose 13 (outside this node).

nodes.name: Mark Previews Ready (3A status)
nodes.notes: Set status to book_assembly_previews_ready; do not set finalBookUrl; record PNG counts + 3A manifest key.

nodes.name: Generate Page Preview Images
nodes.notes: 3A: Include page-00 (dedication) and set canvas to 2625x2625.

nodes.name: Build 3A Manifest
nodes.notes: Refactor: remove PDF fields; include pngGeneration {dedicationImage, storyImages[14], coverSpreadImage}, status=pending_admin_review.

nodes.name: Upload Page Preview Image to R2
Load Canonical Assets
nodes.notes: This node actually loads backgrounds. Expand to include page-00 dedication backgrounds and (optionally) cover assets.

nodes.name: QA Gate (3A Phase 4)
nodes.notes: Phase 4 QA: asserts schema, sizes, presence of p00..p14, p05 overlay annotation, cover key, and null-key sanity. Throws with JSON summary on failure.

nodes.name: Acceptance Tests (3A Phase 5)
nodes.notes: Phase 5 Acceptance: compiles a Markdown report and machine-readable verdict; inspects QA, page coverage, R2 key shapes, cover key, and manifest target.

nodes.name: Store Cloudflare Images ID1
nodes.notes: Extracts Cloudflare Images ID from upload response and combines with page data. Outputs pageNumber, r2Key, cloudflareImageId, and cloudflareImageUrl for manifest building.
